Appreciate the update. Procurement and Legal reviewed the latest Order Form and have redlines focused on publicity and trademark permissions. I attached our marked-up Order Form and our brand guide for context.

High-level asks from ProspectCo Legal:

Below is a concise addendum that preserves Redwood's brand controls while keeping the deal on track. I kept the approval window to 30 days (their ask) but added a few guardrails we should insist on. I'm attaching a one-page redline. Please loop in Dev for the final legal sign-off before sending to ProspectCo.

PROPOSED ADDENDUM LANGUAGE (editable):
"Press and Trademark Use
1. Mutual Approval. Except for announcements excluded in Section 5, neither party shall issue any public announcement, press release, or marketing material that references the other party or this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party. Approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed and shall be provided within thirty (30) days after receipt of a complete draft.
2. Limited Logo Use. Customer (ProspectCo) may use Vendors (Redwood Inference) name and logo solely on Customer's public partner page and in one (1) joint press release relating to the Parties' business relationship, subject to the following: (a) Customer's use must comply with Vendor's then-current brand guidelines and any reasonable usage instructions provided by Vendor; (b) Customer shall submit a proposed use to Vendor at least five (5) business days prior to planned publication; and (c) Vendor may require reasonable edits to ensure compliance with its brand standards.
3. Quotes and Case Studies. Customer may request a brief quote (no more than one complete sentence) from Vendor. Vendor will use commercially reasonable efforts to approve or provide edits within thirty (30) days. Vendor is not obligated to create case study content.
4. No Implied Endorsement. Any permitted use of logos or marks shall not imply endorsement of Customer's products or services beyond the limited rights in this Addendum.
5. Exceptions. This Section does not apply to (a) mandatory disclosures required by law or stock exchange rules, or (b) neutral listings of vendor partners on Customer's website (e.g., partner directory entries that do not contain promotional language), provided Customer follows the brand guidelines.

Rationale and negotiation notes:
- We accept 30 days to keep the timeline tight, but require a 5-business-day pre-notification prior to publication to avoid last-minute compliance issues.
- One-joint-release + partner-page entry satisfies their go-to-market needs with low brand risk.
- Limiting quote length to one sentence reduces scope creep around endorsements.

Next steps: I recommend we (1) attach the one-page addendum to our outbound, (2) CC Dev Patel for legal sign-off, and (3) offer a 20-minute sync to clear any remaining open items today.
